method: All51 non-cog parts use their original filled outer quarter-turn geometry; both arms of each bracket are coupled. All15 freely rotating cogs are represented by the same axis-fixed16-gon strictly inside their independently certified rotation-invariant inscribed disks. Every part chooses either original stock domain, at the original second-sheet material cap. Floor anchors/centers to0.01mm and round all bounds/separating inequalities outward. Drop positive clearance. Use all edge normals of each exact convex-component Minkowski sum; no sampled poses, fixed frame set, fixed cog pose, hint, objective or missing-part allowance. Identical-copy ordering is the only symmetry constraint.
scope: A necessary outer relaxation of the original filled-outline problem, with arbitrary cog angles. A positive outcome is diagnostic only: it lacks actual cog outlines/angles and original clearance and needs further original-shape/native checks. UNKNOWN proves nothing. A negative outcome needs full geometric/model audits. No call retry or extension; no production or H5 acceptance claim.
